messages.content: Think in one short sentence about the plan. Then, in this same assistant turn, call get_weather for Kyoto and lookup for kelivo in parallel, and also use web_search for Kyoto. Do not ask questions. Do not wait for results. Emit both client tool calls together.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Return weather. Always call immediately with the city already given in the user message.

tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Look up a topic. Always call immediately with the topic already given in the user message.
